title: Set up the equation
text: Salt comes in at $$0.2\times20+0.05\times5=4.25$$ kg per minute. The volume stays at $$1000$$ liters, so salt leaves at $$\frac{25y}{1000}=\frac{y}{40}$$ kg per minute. So $$y'=4.25-\frac{y}{40}$$, with $$y(0)=10$$.

title: Separate and solve
text: Rewrite as $$y'=\frac{170-y}{40}$$. Separating and integrating gives $$170-y=A e^{\left(-\frac{t}{40}\right)}$$, and $$y(0)=10$$ gives $$A=160$$. So $$y=170-160e^{\left(-\frac{t}{40}\right)}$$.
